subject: Renewal audit period sync — SOC 2 Type II report + temporary attestation
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@bluecrest.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@bluecrest.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and temporary attestation for renewal

Hi Vanessa,

We're kicking off the renewal for our Redwood contract and procurement has asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the period that overlaps our renewal window. Our renewal cutoff is 2026-09-30 and we need to ensure there is no coverage gap in the attestation we present to our security committee.

Two asks from my side:
- Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a temporary attestation/bridge letter) that would cover any gap between our PO effective date and Redwood's next Type II period?
- Can you also provide a short list of the artifacts procurement will expect (e.g., evidence artifacts, contact for audit questions, expected turnaround) — we want to include this in our purchase request so legal/procurement don't push the renewal out.

If a draft bridge letter is an option, we can accept that while waiting for the formal audit window. Appreciate any timing constraints so I can align our internal approval calendar.

Thanks,
Maria Santos
Senior Procurement Manager
Bluecrest Systems
Attachments: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@bluecrest.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and temporary attestation for renewal

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and context. We're able to support this. High-level next steps:

1) I can send our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering the last completed period) and a draft bridge letter for Bluecrest to use for procurement.
2) I'll include an evidence checklist for typical procurement asks (controls map, key contact list, retention policy excerpt).
3) We need Legal sign-off on the bridge wording; I've looped in Stephanie for a quick review.

Target timeline: I will circulate the SOC 2 PDF + draft bridge and the evidence checklist by end of day Tuesday (2026-08-03). Can you confirm whether Bluecrest needs the attestation to explicitly reference the PO start date or just the renewal effective date? That helps us tailor the draft.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PROVIDED) — redacted report, controls summary included

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: (650) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II and temporary attestation for renewal — internal coordination

Vanessa / Steph — forwarding Bluecrest's ask. Key points: renewal cutoff 2026-09-30, wants SOC2 and bridge cover for gap. Suggested artifacts to include in the packet: controls narrative PDF, list of in-scope services, SOC 2 summary (redacted ok), contact for auditor follow-ups, and sample bridge letter.

Proposed reply flow:
- Send Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted) + controls mapping + evidence checklist + draft bridge_letter_bluecrest_draft.docx
- Ask Bluecrest to confirm whether PO effective date will be prior to 9/30; if so include PO date in bridge preamble.

I've prepared a draft evidence checklist and saved it here: https://redwood-drive.internal/drive/Shared/SOC2/Bridge_Letters/bluecrest-evidence-checklist (internal).

If legal is good with the language on the bridge draft I'll approve sending it to Bluecrest.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II and temporary attestation for renewal — legal review

Thanks — I reviewed the bridge draft (bridge_letter_bluecrest_draft.docx) and the language is approved with a small clarification: include a defined effective window and a sentence that the bridge is an interim attestation that does not extend the formal SOC 2 period. I flagged that text in the draft.

I also recommend attaching the controls summary and an "auditor contact" line (we'll provide a limited contact for direct auditor questions). Once Vanessa confirms the PO effective date wording preference, I can push a final version.

Attaching: bridge_letter_bluecrest_draft.docx (LEGAL REVIEWED)

— Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Legal, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: SOC 2 Type II report + draft bridge letter + evidence checklist

Hi Maria — good to speak with you yesterday. As promised, please find the attached items for Bluecrest's procurement packet:

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II report (controls summary included)
- bridge_letter_bluecrest_draft.docx — draft temporary attestation (legal-reviewed; includes effective window clause)
- audit_timeline_renewal.xlsx — proposed timing for final attestation and recommended PO/contract milestones

A few notes:
- Our draft bridge references a coverage window from 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31 by default; if you need the PO effective date stated explicitly in the bridge preamble, let me know the exact date and we'll update it.
- Evidence checklist (attached inside the SOC2 PDF and as a sheet in the timeline workbook) lists the typical artifacts procurement requests: in-scope system descriptions, controls narratives, incident response summary (last 12 months), and auditor contact info.
- Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the draft bridge wording and advise on PO timing so we can finalize and deliver a signed attestation. If Bluecrest would like a DocuSign workflow, we can route once the dates are confirmed.

Let me know if you'd like a quick call to walk procurement through the packet — happy to join.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
